kind: Standalone CL/NPU/CL FP16 draft-head microdiagnostic v2
domain: Synthetic FP16 draft-domain activations only; no full Transformer or draft loaded.

protocol.order: Alternates GPU/hybrid then hybrid/GPU each round
protocol.includes: Includes activation cast/pack, all host bridges, submits/cache syncs, collection, GPU upload/cast and final sync
protocol.excludes: Standalone loading and NPU weight preparation are recorded separately, not amortized into these per-call medians.

full_output_validation.comparison_gate: abs(hybrid-gpu) <= 0.002 + 0.003*abs(gpu), evaluated elementwise over complete outputs

independent_fp32_reference.sampled_columns: Tile boundaries plus pinned random columns

memory.scope: Standalone resident head only; not full-model/draft or simultaneous-serving memory qualification.

standalone_load.scope: standalone target head only; no full Transformer/draft loaded

measured_source_cohort.scope: Measured micro cohort only; no evolving-current or trained-model/API qualification implied.

outer_lease_observation.scope: The original lease report remains failed/preserved. It is not the source of the subsequent restoration claim.

earlier_v1_preflight.outcome: Wrong interpreter preflight failed before either serving model was unloaded; no NPU timing was produced. The false restored flag is not evidence that existing sessions were changed.
earlier_v1_preflight.execution_context_source: Parent execution report; the preserved job independently shows preflight-only status.

pending: Trained NPU-head integration and API qualification remain pending. The separate v7 trained cohort used CL compute and did not exercise this NPU route.
limits: All activations are synthetic; full-output allclose and argmax checks do not establish trained-draft acceptance, target quality or LLM speed.
This is eight-row FP16 draft-domain work; no one-row FP32 target-decode qualification.
GPU weights come from the actual pinned checkpoint, but the experiment loads only the shared head.
Current streaming implementation makes 21 submits per hybrid call; it does not batch different output-weight tiles into one submission.
No full-model memory, long-context stability or concurrent-serving qualification follows from the standalone peak.

restoration_recovery.scope: Supplemental verification following the same GPU load retry; recovery establishes restoration independently of the failed original lease.

post_recovery_primary_health.scope: Real two-token replies after head-micro recovery and before the separate v7 lease; not an ongoing-state or performance benchmark claim.
